idh.reasoning: The metadata show an aggressive, expansile infiltrative tumor with substantial enhancing and non-enhancing components, necrosis, marked edema, midline shift, ventricular/ependymal invasion, deep white-matter invasion, and enhancement/edema crossing midline. These features favor an IDH-wildtype diffuse glioma phenotype over an IDH-mutant astrocytoma, which more often presents as a less enhancing lower-grade-appearing lesion. Features arguing against IDH-wildtype include frontal/insular/cortical involvement and age 49, which can be seen with IDH-mutant glioma. Overall, the aggressive enhancement-necrosis-edema pattern and invasive behavior support IDH-wildtype.

The cortical and frontal/insular location could fit an oligodendroglial tumor, so those features argue against a non-codeleted call. However, the aggressive necrotic, edematous, invasive pattern weighs more strongly toward non-codeleted status.
